title: Consistency bound for a different matrix
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $\Gamma\in\mathbb F_2^{n\times n}$ differ from the matrix with entries $\gamma_i\gamma_j$. For independent uniform vectors $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the probability that $(\gamma\cdot x)(\gamma\cdot y)=\sum_{i,j=1}^n\Gamma_{ij}x_i y_j$ in $\mathbb F_2$ is at most $3/4$.
